summary: The study fabricated one freestanding Ti3C2Tx MXene film electrode by LiF/HCl etching of Ti3AlC2, delamination, and vacuum filtration. The same Ti3C2Tx film was used as both electrodes in symmetric devices; changing KI concentration in electrolyte does not create distinct electrode materials. Its best device performance occurred in 3 M H2SO4 + 0.3 M KI, reaching 601 F cm−3 and 166 F g−1 at 1 A g−1. The film thickness, flake-size range, and XRD interlayer spacing were reported, whereas BET surface area, porosity, pore diameter, tortuosity, and device-specific mass loading were not reported.
